result.summary: G1, G2, G3 and F-1..F-5 resolved in r1. Two tiny inconsistencies fixed directly (rev r1a). One item for the SEC gate: S-1b (mode_under_lock! returns :off for a malformed prefix or a schema with no tenants row). GO for SECURITY-REVIEWER design gate.

independent_verification.G1: 3.9a: sync_role_claims_report/3 in Letflow.Identity returns {:ok, user} | {:suppressed, user, summary}; arity-3 export keeps User.t() as a thin wrapper (callers identity.ex 3565/3591/3601 and the pipeline unchanged); items carry ids and a fixed kind only; failure fallback maps to {:ok, original user}. No Identity export pin exists in test/ (only RoleScopeGrants is pinned). T-S13/T-S14 and MU-45/46 present. Resolved.
independent_verification.G2: 3.6a: in `on` Backfill.repair_tenant skips repair, the :gap_remains check and the scope.backfill_completed audit, returns skipped_enforced: true with the real T9 count; off/shadow unchanged; dry run gains the flag; run/1 adds skipped_enforced_tenants and continues; T-N5a/b/c, MU-43/44 present. Consistent with the as-built repair_tenant (lock A, count, repair loop, gap check, audit only when inserted > 0). Resolved.
independent_verification.G3: Grep of lib for the six functions outside role_scope_grants.ex: role_registry.ex 304/534/565/576/789, tenant_admin_migration.ex 349/398, identity.ex 1026, backfill.ex 193 (9 and 104 are doc text), plus the single Backfill.run caller (lib/mix/tasks/letflow.backfill_role_scope_grants.ex:42; the other two `Backfill.run` hits are TenantProvisioning/LoginDirectory modules, excluded by alias resolution). This equals the design's scanned set, so the scan passes on main. Indirect rows (W-g1, W-g2, W-h, M-a..M-f) are checked by T-C2 (named function exists). Resolved; the mix-task caller now has an explicit row W-e2 (r1a).
independent_verification.F-1: 3.2 now returns :off for a malformed prefix or an absent tenants row and raises only when the read fails; this removes the risk to existing tests with hand-made schema names (role_registry_test.exs, simulation tests), and T-L1 asserts it. No new RoleScopeGrants export (pinned). The relaxation is reasonable: the flag lives only in that row, so no enforced state can exist for such a schema, and the Registration FK guarantees a row for every provisioned tenant. It does weaken the r0 'never default to off' stance, so it is correctly listed as SEC S-1b; INV-1 row updated to match.
independent_verification.F-2_F-5: M-f row present; TAM skip also skips legacy-binding removal and token rewrite and is folded into S-1; on_gate integrity test moved to 2f-a (8.3 line); RA-10 present.

mode_under_lock! returning :off for a malformed prefix or missing tenants row is a deliberate fail-open for a schema that cannot be enforced. SEC should rule on it explicitly together with S-1.
